description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao's getDataGroupPermissions method, testing various permission filtering scenarios within the authorization data access layer of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetDataGroupPermissionsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing DataGroupDao's getDataGroupPermissions method, including various permission filtering scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including loading fixture data and instantiating DataGroupDao.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEmptyParams
methods.description: Tests getDataGroupPermissions with default parameters, expecting no permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithAdmin
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval for an admin user role, expecting full read and create permissions without update/delete.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEss
methods.description: Tests permissions for an 'ess' user role, expecting read permission only.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithoutApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor role without the withApiDataGroups flag, expecting read permissions only.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor role with the withApiDataGroups flag, expecting multiple permissions including delete.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsNotOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval with onlyAccessible set to false, expecting all relevant data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests permissions with onlyAccessible true, expecting a subset based on accessibility.
